title: Abiding in Christ
definition: Abiding in Christ is the believer's continual dependence, fellowship, obedience, and fruitfulness in union with Jesus.
summary: Abiding in Christ is the believer's daily dependence on Jesus as the source of life, obedience, communion, and fruit.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the true vine, and His disciples bear fruit only as they abide in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine centers on remaining in living fellowship with Christ. Abiding is not passive drifting; it is continual dependence, receiving His Word, obeying His commands, and drawing life from Him like branches from a vine. The Christian life is fruitful because Christ supplies what the believer cannot produce alone.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because believers often try to live for Christ without consciously depending on Christ. Abiding exposes self-sufficiency and replaces it with communion. It also comforts weak disciples by reminding them that fruit comes from remaining in the Savior, not from spiritual performance alone.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Begin ordinary days by turning your attention to Christ, His Word, and His presence. Ask where you are striving apart from Him. Measure fruitfulness by faithful dependence before visible results.
